title: AI broke the cybersecurity world. What’s next?
slides: Did AI just break cybersecurity forever?
Attackers now deploy AI agents that adapt mid-breach
Defenders found one tactic the machines miss entirely
Your team can test it on one live incident this week
Run that test before your next breach does
thread_text:
1. AI just broke cybersecurity?

Attackers now deploy autonomous agents that adapt mid-breach — not scripted playbooks, but live decision-making during the attack itself.

2. Adaptive agents change the game

They learn the environment in real time, pivot when blocked, and exploit weaknesses as they find them. Static defenses can't keep up.

3. One tactic machines miss

Defenders found a technique that confuses AI agents entirely. It exploits how they perceive the network — a blind spot in their reasoning.

4. Test it on one live incident

Your team can run this tactic on a single real incident this week. No new tools needed — just a shift in how you respond.

5. Run the test before they do

Pick one active incident and apply the tactic today. If you haven't tried it, your next breach will test it for you. Does your team know where to start?
